item.name: Exchange token for Iceberg REST access

request.name: Exchange token for Iceberg REST access

description.content:
Exchange credentials for Open Source (OSS) Iceberg REST Client (IRC).

OSS IRC (< 1.10.x) uses 2 grant types:
- token-exchange: Defined by the OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange spec (RFC 8693).
  Exchange a valid, unexpired (OAuth) access token for a new access token with the same or smaller scopes.
- client_credentials: Defined by the OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework spec (RFC 6749).
  Exchange a client credential (i.e. Wherobots API Key) for an access token.

Use cases:
1. [client_credentials] Users who has an API key yet no OAuth JWT token.
Request format:
    {
        "grant_type": "client_credentials",
        "client_id": "<customer_id>", (Wherobots Customer Ext ID)
        "client_secret": "<api_key>", (Wherobots API Key)
        "scope": "<requested_scope>" ("catalog" for now, to be extended in the future)
    }
2. [token-exchange] Users who already has an valid, unexpired OAuth JWT token.
Request format:
    {
        "grant_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange", (OSS IRC always use this exact string)
        "scope": "<requested_scope>",
        "subject_token": "<current_unexpired_access_token>",
        "subject_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token", (OSS IRC always use this exact string)
        "actor_token": "<optional_actor_token>", (not used currently)
        "actor_token_type": "<actor_token_type>" (not used currently)
    }
Note: the optional actor_token is used for permission delegation, which is NOT
currently supported, and thus has no effect even if provided. The "subject_token_type"
has to be "access_token" at the moment - we currently only support exchanging access tokens.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
